description: AI-DIST: distances the AI reasons with to an enemy unit are measured between the two CLOSEST models (edge-to-edge), not unit centroid to centroid. 9 Beast Snagga Boyz (2 rows) and a 3-model Custodian Guard Sodality line are placed so the nearest bases are 14.2" apart while the centroids are 20.1" apart. The AI's nearest-enemy helper returns 14.2" and the Suggest card's charge-intent line reports 14.2", never 20.1".

steps.comment: geometry: 9 Boyz (2 rows) vs a 3-model Custodian Guard line — closest bases 14.2" apart edge-to-edge, unit centroids 20.1" apart
AI-DIST: the AI's nearest-enemy distance is the closest-model edge gap, not the centroid gap

steps.script: main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("Charge intent: Beast Snagga Boyz → Custodian Guard Sodality (14.2\" away)")
steps.comment: the card's charge-intent line reports the 14.2" closest-model gap
the 20.1" centroid gap must not appear anywhere on the card
scroll the card so the AI's-notes charge-intent line is on screen for the screenshot
